posts.text:
Todd Blanche is a dedicated public servant and accomplished lawyer whose career speaks for itself. 

Todd's ability to serve this country has been proven during his time as Deputy AG and Acting AG these past several months. It's thanks to him that the Task Force on Fraud has been able to arrest so many fraudsters and protect Americans' hard-earned tax dollars. 

I know Todd will continue to serve the American people and the Trump Administration loyally, and he will make a great Attorney General.

posts.text:
The @WHFraudTF had a great week!

- @FBIDirectorKash arrested one of America's Most Wanted fraudsters for $547M in fraud

- @SecScottBessent successfully implemented a verification process to stop payments from going to dead people

- @SecretaryTurner suspended funding to the Virgin Islands amid a massive fraud investigation

- @SecKennedy, @DrOzCMS deferred $1B in Medicaid payments to CA and MN

Fraudsters be warned: if you steal from the American people, we will hunt you down.
